purpose: Explain project-root scope, fallback rules, folders, files, extensions, auto-save, defaults, duplicate protection, reset behavior, and the non-destructive analysis boundary.
display_lines: Exclusion Rules controls what supported KANDA workflows treat as outside the project.
Select the exact Project Root before editing project-specific rules.
Folder, file, and extension lists are separate and auto-save immediately.
Built-in defaults are merged with saved project-specific rules.
Excluded items remain on disk and are not deleted.
